references.text: The promise that Abraham's descendants will become numerous and take possession of their enemies' gates – almost identical wording to the blessing given to Rebekah.
Isaac blesses Jacob with a similar blessing, asking God to make him fruitful and numerous, and to give him Abraham's blessing.
God's promise to Abraham that Sarah will become the mother of nations, and that kings will come from her.
The blessing at Ruth's marriage to Boaz – a parallel to the family's blessing of Rebekah when she departed for marriage.
Those who belong to Christ are Abraham's descendants and heirs according to the promise – the spiritual fulfillment of the promise of numerous offspring.
